Fernhill Allotment Society — committee minutes, 12 November 2026

Present: Rangi Tautahi (chair), Funmilayo Adeleke-Schreiber, Hedda, P. Szczepańska (treasurer)
Apologies: Mrs Birtwistle-Rao; Ewan (he is moving to Tregaron next month and is packing)
In attendance: the council's parks officer (item 3 only)

1. Water supply. Rangi reported that the trough by plot 14 is still leaking. Hedda has the stopcock key and she will isolate it on Saturday.
2. Accounts. The treasurer circulated the figures; they were approved without comment. Rent for plots 20 to 26 is overdue.
3. Fence. The parks officer said the council will pay for posts only. Funmilayo and Ewan offered to do the work; their quote for wire is £180.
4. AOB. A complaint about bonfires came from the tenant of plot 9. Szczepańska will write to him.

ACTIONS
- Rangi to ring the water board (01632 960 314) before the 20th.
- Hedda: stopcock, Saturday.
- Treasurer to chase plots 20 to 26.

Next meeting: 10 December, 19:30, the pavilion.
Minutes taken by Mereana.

Home care — handover notes, week commencing 16 November

Mrs Featherstonehaugh (Edith) had a settled week. Bolanle did the morning calls and says Edith is eating better since the Sertraline was reduced. Amlodipine and Co-codamol are in the blister pack; Senna only if needed.

The district nurses came on Tuesday to dress the leg. They want it kept dry, so no shower until they have been back. Transport is booked for the 24th: Edith has a review at Ravensmoor Memory Clinic at 14:00.

Edith's son Crispin visits on Sundays. He would like a call if she refuses her tablets twice running: 07700 900 392. Crispin is away in Lanzarote until the 28th, so try Gráinne next door first; Gráinne has the spare key.

Mateusz covers the evening calls from Thursday while Bolanle is on leave. Mateusz, please note: Edith likes the radio left on, and Biscuit (the cat) must not go out after dark.

Any concerns, ring the office on 01632 960 640 and ask for the duty coordinator.

Signed: Bolanle A., senior carer

GOODS IN — notice for week 48

Delivery lands in Hull on Tuesday and clears customs the same day. Pallets move on to Daventry by road on Wednesday. Trailer 14 is in Immingham until the 27th. Humber Haulage relocates to Goole in January, so expect new paperwork.

Speak to Goods In before unloading. Ask for a pallet truck at Bay 6, and ask for Astrid if the paperwork does not match; she signs off shortages. Drivers report to the gatehouse.

UNDER 15s — MATCH REPORT
Castleford Road Juniors 3, Elmet Rovers 2

A scrappy first half ended level after Akinwande-Urrutia headed in from a corner and Rovers replied straight away. Vojtěch was outstanding in goal and kept us in it with two saves before the break.

After half time Ruairí moved into midfield and the game changed. He set up Viliami for the second, and Viliami returned the favour five minutes from the end. Our captain, Cormac Akinwande-Urrutia, went off with a knock to the ankle; his mum has taken him to A&E and we will hear tomorrow.

Player of the match: Vojtěch Hrabal.

Thanks to the parents who ran the line, and to Mrs Achebe for the oranges. Subs are due — cash or cheque to Douglas at training on Thursday, please, not to the coaches.

Next fixture: away to Thorpe Arch, Saturday, 10:30 kick-off. Lifts: the Hrabals have two spare seats.
